one_liner: Website builder and hosted ecommerce platform with Commerce APIs.

auth.notes: Site owners can generate a static API key for their own site; third-party integrations distributed to other users' sites must register as an OAuth2 client, which Squarespace manually reviews before issuing client_id/client_secret.

access.notes: Getting an OAuth client for a third-party integration requires registering with Squarespace, who review the registration before issuing credentials; a single-site API key is simpler but only scoped to one site the developer already owns/admins.

api.notes: Commerce API covers orders, inventory, products, transactions; did not count exact endpoints this pass.

verdict.rationale: Building for arbitrary Squarespace merchants requires Squarespace's manual OAuth client review before credentials are issued.
